Inspect actual functional simulation phase warps against identity time

etr_plot_functional_simulation_phase_warps.Rd

The source-comparable geometry draws the identity time map followed by actual native phase functions in original curve order, with the same number of curves and transparency as frozen Python 1.2. Renderer remains native base R and never returns real Python Matplotlib axes.

Usage

etr_plot_functional_simulation_phase_warps(
    result, max_curves = 20L, alpha = 0.35,
    strict_source_record = FALSE)

Arguments

result

Genuine native simulated functional truth, including phase warps evaluated on the same truth grid.

max_curves

Positive whole number of first-seen curves, or NULL for all curves.

alpha

Finite transparency within (0,1].

strict_source_record

If TRUE, return a source-ordered line artist record with dashed identity mapping followed by original retained phase warps, instead of the default R numeric-geometry list.

Value

Default invisible time grid, identity and warps; strict mode provides inspectable source-scientific line and legend data.
